newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers say May election almost certain.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers say May election almost certain.

text.p: Bookmakers William Hill said on Tuesday that it had cut the odds on a British election taking place in May to 2-9 from 2-7.
William Hill offers April at 3-1, March at 9-1 and February 20-1. The election must be called by May 22.
Prime Minister John Major said earlier that he was ready to "play it long" on the election, reinforcing the belief that he intends to hold the election on May 1.
Labour are 3-10 favourites to win the election with the ruling Conservatives on 9-4.
